The '''''Oldskep''''' was a [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]] that was used by the company [[Imperial Mining, Ltd.]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], which was named after an IML executive. After IML established a base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alluuvia]] in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]], the ''Oldskep'' was laden with supplies and dispatched to the [[Alluuvian system]], accompanied by the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Berea-3]]'' and eight [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]]. However, on arrival in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], the IML [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was attacked and defeated by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] ship and the [[Shepherd-class shuttle|''Shepherd''-class]] [[Ithorian Herdship|Herdship]] ''[[Varnay]]''.
